item.title: 20-Years-Owned 1965 Ford Mustang Convertible A-Code 289 4-Speed
item.description: This 1965 Ford Mustang convertible is powered by an A-code 289ci V8 linked to a four-speed manual transmission. It was acquired by the seller in 2006 and has been refinished with Poppy red paintwork, GT-style equipment, 14" styled-steel wheels, and a black deluxe interior. Service in 2025 totaled over $4,500 and involved an overhaul of the cooling system and a refresh of the brakes. This A-code Mustang is now offered with recent service records and a clean Florida title in the seller's name.

item.title: 1995 Ducati 916 at No Reserve

item.title: Original-Owner, 2,900-Mile 2009 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500KR at No Reserve
item.description: This 2009 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500KR is #54 of 712 examples produced for the model year, and it was purchased new by the current owner, who has added its 2,900 miles. The car is powered by a supercharged 5.4-liter V8 paired with a six-speed manual transmission and is finished in Brilliant Silver over Dark Charcoal leather. item.title: 1975 Cadillac Eldorado Convertible
item.description: This 1975 Cadillac Eldorado is a triple-white convertible powered by a 500ci V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission. It has a Continental kit, front disc brakes, and 15" steel wheels with polished covers along with steer horns, a power-adjustable front bench seat, a push-button stereo, cruise control, and electric windows. This Eldorado Convertible was acquired by the selling dealer on BaT in June 2021 and is now offered in Arkansas with a clean New York title.

item.title: 1972 Ford F-100 Ranger XLT
item.description: This 1972 Ford F-100 Ranger XLT was initially sold at a Ford dealership in Portland, Oregon, and is said to have remained in the state under the care of a single family before the seller's September 2025 purchase. It is finished in Calypso Coral over black vinyl and cloth, and it is powered by a 360ci V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 2004 Jaguar XJ8 at No Reserve
item.description: This 2004 Jaguar XJ8 has remained registered in California from new and now has 62k miles. item.description: This 2004 Ferrari 360 Challenge Stradale is one of approximately 1,300 examples produced worldwide, and it was registered in California and Montana before it was acquired in 2016 by the current owner, a Ferrari collector.
